builds.name: Curtain Call: fourth bullet execution
builds.summary: Investigate high one fourth Curtain Call bullet output under fixed, reproducible conditions; compare one-slot swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high one fourth Curtain Call bullet output under fixed, reproducible conditions; compare one-slot swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: Each ordinary bullet starts at 64/128/192 + 0.25 total AD and increases with enemy missing health, up to fourfold. The tooltip gives the fourth bullet a 200% critical strike. Whisper converts crit and bonus attack speed into AD; use observed AD. Whether Infinity Edge modifies this special critical multiplier requires direct testing.
